shortDescription: Perform the Certificate Signing Request Sign action.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: caref
options.description: The certificate authority to sign the certificate with.

options.name: csr
options.description: The X509 certificate signing request to sign.

options.name: descr
options.description: The descriptive name for this certificate.

options.name: digest_alg
options.description: The digest method used when the certificate is signed.

options.name: dn_dns_sans
options.description: The DNS Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate.

options.name: dn_email_sans
options.description: The Email Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate.

options.name: dn_ip_sans
options.description: The IP Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate.

options.name: dn_uri_sans
options.description: The URI Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate.

options.name: lifetime
options.description: The number of days the certificate is valid for.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of certificate to generate.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
